event_name: Date 22 May 2022 Time 16:01 2022 SPANISH GRAND PRIX 19 - 22 May 2022 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
offence: Breach of Article 2 d) Chapter IV Appendix L of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed the video evidence. Stroll was fully alongside on the outside of Gasly from turn-in to the apex, and gave Gasly sufficient room. Gasly understeered into Stroll and the Stewards found him wholly at fault for the collision, although the collision was more due to a lack of grip.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Offence Car 10 Causing A Collision With Car 18
